name: JoAi: Update Fulfillment

description.en: Update fulfillment status and/or tracking details (carrier and tracking number).
description.de: Fulfillment-Status und/oder Tracking-Daten aktualisieren (Carrier und Sendungsnummer).
description.fr: Met à jour le statut d’expédition et/ou les infos de suivi (transporteur et numéro).
description.es: Actualiza el estado del envío y/o los datos de seguimiento (transportista y número).
description.it: Aggiorna lo stato dell’evasione e/o i dati di tracking (corriere e numero).
description.ro: Actualizează statusul livrării și/sau datele de tracking (curier și număr).

bot: Use when the user wants to mark an order as shipped, delivered, ready for pickup, or cancelled — or to correct tracking after a typo. Status is optional when only updating carrierCode/trackingNumber. Use a known carrier id (post_at, dhl, dpd, gls, ups, fedex, hermes) so trackingUrl is auto-filled. If the fulfillment ID is unknown, list fulfillments for the order first.

inputs.name: Fulfillment ID

description.en: The ID of the fulfillment to update
description.de: Die ID des zu aktualisierenden Fulfillments
description.fr: L'ID de l'expédition à mettre à jour
description.es: El ID del envío a actualizar

inputs.bot: The fulfillment ID. List fulfillments for the order if unknown.

description.en: New fulfillment status (optional when only updating tracking)
description.fr: Nouveau statut d'expédition (optionnel si vous corrigez seulement le suivi)
description.es: Nuevo estado del envío (opcional si solo corriges el seguimiento)
description.it: Nuovo stato dell'evasione (opzionale se correggi solo il tracking)
description.ro: Noul status al livrării (opțional dacă doar corectezi tracking-ul)

inputs.name: Carrier Code

description.en: Carrier id (optional): post_at, dhl, dpd, gls, ups, fedex, hermes
description.de: Carrier-ID (optional): post_at, dhl, dpd, gls, ups, fedex, hermes
description.fr: ID transporteur (optionnel) : post_at, dhl, dpd, gls, ups, fedex, hermes
description.es: ID del transportista (opcional): post_at, dhl, dpd, gls, ups, fedex, hermes
description.it: ID corriere (opzionale): post_at, dhl, dpd, gls, ups, fedex, hermes
description.ro: ID curier (opțional): post_at, dhl, dpd, gls, ups, fedex, hermes

inputs.bot: Must be a known carrier id (post_at, dhl, dpd, gls, ups, fedex, hermes). The API builds the tracking URL.

description.en: Tracking number (optional). The API builds the tracking URL for known carriers.
description.de: Sendungsnummer (optional). Die API setzt die Tracking-URL für bekannte Carrier.
description.fr: Numéro de suivi (optionnel). L’API génère l’URL de suivi pour les transporteurs connus.
description.es: Número de seguimiento (opcional). La API genera la URL para transportistas conocidos.
description.it: Numero di tracking (opzionale). L’API genera l’URL per i corrieri noti.
description.ro: Număr de tracking (opțional). API-ul generează URL-ul pentru curierii cunoscuți.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.fr: Slug d'équipe pour cette action. Par défaut l'équipe actuelle.
description.es: Slug del equipo para esta acción. Por defecto el equipo actual.
description.it: Slug del team per questa azione. Predefinito: team attuale.
description.ro: Slug-ul echipei pentru această acțiune. Implicit echipa curentă.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
